'''2018 European MPC Results Kevin Jaap LS Diplomatic Mission To Alderaan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Jaap]] at [[2018 European Match Play Championship]] (Results).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Kevin Jaap]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 European Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Diplomatic Mission To Alderaan / A Weakness Can Be Found|V3-L-diplomaticmissiontoalderaan.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Diplomatic Mission To Alderaan Jaap.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-match-play-championships/ PC list]
